title: Proof
body_md:
Let 
\[
G_n^{(m)}(v) =\dfrac{1}{2} \left(1+ \frac{1}{\Delta t_m}\right)\left(\int^1_0v^2dx - 2\int^1_0u_n^{(m-1)}vdx \right).
\]
Then \cref{splitE} and \cref{functionalACn} give
\[
J_n^{(m)}\bigl(v\bigr) = {\@fontswitch{\relax}{\mathcal} E}(v) + G_n^{(m)}(v) -\dfrac14 -\beta v(1).
\]
Since $G_n^{(m)}(v_n)-G_n^{(m)}\left(u_n^{(m-1)}\right)= \frac{1}{2}\Bigl(1 + \frac{1}{\Delta t_m}\Bigr)
\left\|v_n - u_n^{(m-1)}\right\|^2$, we have
\begin{comment}
                             
                                                           
                                                               
                                                  
              
     
             
                                                                                         
                                      
                                                         
                                                  
                                                                   
                                                           
                                                          
                                                               
                                                            
           
                                                              
                                          
\end{comment}
\[
J_n^{(m)}\bigl(v_n\bigr) - J_n^{(m)}\bigl(u_n^{(m-1)}\bigr)
= {\@fontswitch{\relax}{\mathcal} E}\bigl(v_n\bigr) - {\@fontswitch{\relax}{\mathcal} E}\bigl(u_n^{(m-1)}\bigr)
- \beta\Bigl(v_n(1) - u_n^{(m-1)}(1)\Bigr)
+ \frac{1}{2}\Bigl(1 + \frac{1}{\Delta t_m}\Bigr)
\bigl\|v_n - u_n^{(m-1)}\bigr\|^2,
\]
which, together with the assumption, implies \cref{NNdecay}. This completes the proof of the lemma.

title: Proof
body_md:
\cref{NNdecaysum} follows directly from the summation of \cref{NNdecay} with $v_n= u_n^{(m)}$ over $m$ from $1$ to $N$,                                                                              
and \cref{NNenergydecay} is a direct consequence of \cref{NNdecaysum} and the assumption that $\beta=0$. The first inequality in \cref{NNstab} follows from \cref{NNenergydecay} and the fact that 
\[
\frac{\varepsilon^2}{2}\,\bigl|v\bigr|_{H^1(I)}^2 \leq {\@fontswitch{\relax}{\mathcal} E}(v) \quad\forall\, \, v \in H^1(I).
\]
Finally, using $u_n^{(N)}(0) = \alpha$, the fundamental theorem of calculus, and the Cauchy–Schwarz
inequality, we have 
\[
\bigl|u_n^{(N)}(x)\bigr| \leq |\alpha| + \int_0^x \bigl|\bigl(u_n^{(N)}\bigr)'(s)\bigr|\,ds
\leq |\alpha| + \bigl|u_n^{(N)}\bigr|_{H^1(I)} ,
\]
for all $x \in I$, which, combined with the first inequality in \cref{NNstab}, gives the validity of the second inequality. This completes the proof of the theorem.
